paragraphs: Rav Yehuda bar Achotai. Mentioned in Keritot 13b, where he said that the halakhah follows Rabbi Elazar.[^1]

notes.text: Keritot 13b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic explicitly has Rav Yehuda bar Achotai saying הלכה כרבי אלעזר. This supports Rabbi Elazar for this occurrence of ר״א, superseding the earlier unsupported Akiva expansion and resolving the earlier Eliezer/Elazar alternatives locally.
